findings: extensions/navigate-tree/retrospective-plan.ts: readSessionSnapshot validates append-ordered parent existence and unique IDs, checks tool-call/result pairing, and computes pendingToolCalls; validateCompleteToolCalls blocks unfinished source calls before cloning/proposal work. Verified source behavior.

extensions/navigate-tree/index.ts: completeRewind validates target/label and projected reduction/headroom before branching, and attempts best-effort leaf restoration if branch writing throws. Likely recovery risk: restoration errors are swallowed, so dual write/restore failure could leave the tree moved despite reporting failure.

extensions/navigate-tree/index.ts and continuity-store.test.ts: fold reconciles branch-local continuity state and embeds a snapshot/briefing in handoff; tests describe snapshot replacement and corrupt-snapshot fallback to prior ledger with warning. Test descriptions are not claims of executed tests.

extensions/navigate-tree/index.ts: pending rewind freezes the projected request at instruction time, hides failed attempts, records outcomes, gates tools, and handles abort/failure paths; completeRewind prechecks net context/headroom. Verified source behavior.

README.md: documents a possible continuation failure when a later turn_end draft targets an abandoned entry: Pi may drop the whole boundary after the branch has moved, leaving the landed fold unannounced. This is a documented risk, not an independently reproduced failure.
extensions/navigate-tree/continuity-ledger.ts: rewindLedger preserves monotonic revision/identity progression when rewinding ledger state.

extensions/navigate-tree/auto-navigate.ts: evaluateAutoNavigateTurn budgets UTF-8 payload size, limits anchors to fully exposed records, validates names/IDs, and returns no action on malformed model output or errors. Verified source behavior.

extensions/navigate-tree/auto-navigate.ts: summaryFocus is trimmed and length-checked (minimum 60 characters) but not semantically checked against the latest instruction or outstanding obligations. Likely continuation risk: a syntactically valid but incomplete focus may lose required handoff context.

extensions/navigate-tree/continuity-store.ts: readBranchLedger replaces replay state at snapshots and warns/skips malformed operations or snapshots rather than discarding the prior ledger. retrospective-cloning.md documents staged per-file publication but no multi-file transaction, so crashes may leave a partial clone family.

extensions/navigate-tree/index.ts: rewind/overflow continuation projects canonical context and carries late inputs; planWithhold limits edits to projected results and reprojects estimates. Verified source behavior.

extensions/navigate-tree/retrospective.ts: validates ranges, tool batches, and state before staging files; documentation acknowledges publication-family rollback is not atomic, leaving a possible partial-publication recovery risk.

extensions/navigate-tree/config.ts: field-wise merge makes an invalid hint disable rather than fall back, while invalid anchor-start/parent-mode values fall back; file-level parse/read errors ignore a layer. extensions/navigate-tree/continuity-ledger.ts parseLedger strictly validates IDs/revisions/lineage; rewindLedger is documented/tested as preserving monotonic IDs.
